summary.key_theme: 市場對於 Tesla 的 Robotaxi 與 Cybercab 商業化進程抱持高度期待，但同時面臨機構減持、估值過高以及競爭對手崛起的多重壓力。

bullish.title: Tesla Lands 500-Truck Order From Einride in World's Largest Tesla Semi Deployment
bullish.reason: Einride 訂購 500 輛 Tesla Semi，這是該車型有史以來最大規模的部署，顯示 Tesla 在商用電動卡車市場的競爭力獲得實質驗證。

bullish.title: Tesla’s Steering-Wheel-Free Cybercab Could Hit Austin Streets This Month as Elon Musk Ramps Up Robotaxi Push
bullish.reason: Tesla 預計在奧斯汀推出無方向盤的 Cybercab，象徵其自動駕駛技術進入商業化落地階段，是股價的重要催化劑。

bullish.title: JPMorgan Says Tesla Is Confident of Scaling Cybercab Operations, Touts Future Models Based on Platform
bullish.reason: 摩根大通指出 Tesla 對擴展 Cybercab 營運充滿信心，且 FSD V15 版本被視為技術上的重大突破，有利於長期獲利能力。

bullish.title: EXCLUSIVE: Nvidia Partner Says Tesla, Waymo Are Growing the Physical AI Market
bullish.reason: Ouster CEO 指出 Tesla 正在推動物理 AI 市場的成長，而非單純的競爭關係，提升了市場對 Tesla AI 戰略的估值預期。

bullish.title: Paul Graham Says Tesla Buyers Are Getting More Range, More Car For Less Money Than A Decade Ago
bullish.reason: 知名投資人 Paul Graham 肯定 Tesla 的產品性價比提升，有助於品牌形象與市場滲透率的維持。

bullish.title: Former Tesla President Says Roadster Demo Could Be a ‘Not-So-Hidden Attempt’ to Knit TSLA and SPCX Together
bullish.reason: 前總裁 Jon McNeill 認為 Roadster 演示可能暗示 Tesla 與 SpaceX 的深度合作，市場對此類技術整合抱持正面想像。

bullish.title: Cathie Wood Says Elon Musk's Tesla Playbook Explains Why She's Avoiding SK Hynix and Micron
bullish.reason: Cathie Wood 強調 Tesla 的戰略優勢，間接強化了投資人對 Tesla 作為 AI 領頭羊的信心。

bullish.title: Idea for flying Roadster has been around 'since the beginning': Former Tesla president Jon McNeill
bullish.reason: 關於飛行 Roadster 的討論增加了市場對 Tesla 創新能力的關注度。

bearish.title: Viking Global Shifts Gears: Andreas Halvorsen Makes $817 Million Bet on Ferrari, Slashes Tesla Stake by 78% in Q2
bearish.reason: Viking Global 大幅減持 Tesla 78% 的持股，顯示大型機構投資人對其短期成長潛力或估值存在疑慮。

bearish.title: GLJ Research Reiterates Sell on Tesla, Maintains $24.86 Price Target
bearish.reason: GLJ Research 維持賣出評級與極低的目標價，反映了市場對 Tesla 估值過高的強烈看空聲音。

bearish.title: Gary Black Has ‘Low Interest’ in Tesla Stock at Current Price, Even With a Potential SpaceX Buyout
bearish.reason: Gary Black 對當前股價表示興趣缺缺，提醒投資人需注意估值風險與管理層的執行力問題。

bearish.title: Prediction: Cybercab Adds Less Than 5% to Tesla's Revenue in Its First Full Year
bearish.reason: 分析指出 Cybercab 在首年對營收貢獻不到 5%，這可能打擊市場對 Robotaxi 業務短期獲利爆發的過度樂觀預期。

bearish.title: Gary Black Says Tesla Bulls On Social Media Are Like College Students Doing 'Tequila Shots'
bearish.reason: Gary Black 批評社群媒體上的多頭過於盲目，提醒市場情緒可能過熱，存在回調風險。

bearish.title: I drove Tesla FSD, Rivian Autonomy+ ‘hands-free’ driving systems. Here’s how they compare
bearish.reason: 評測指出競爭對手 Rivian 正積極追趕自動駕駛技術，顯示 Tesla 在技術護城河上面臨日益激烈的競爭。

neutral.title: Stocks making the biggest moves premarket: Home Depot, Tesla, Fabrinet, Duolingo & more
neutral.reason: 僅為盤前交易動態的例行報導，未提供具體基本面分析。

neutral.title: Moderna, Walmart, Coinbase, Deere, SpaceX, Tesla, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
neutral.reason: 綜合性市場回顧，提及 Tesla 僅作為當日市場波動的一部分，無特殊利多或利空訊息。

neutral.title: Tesla Optimus Rival Unitree Robotics Explodes 629% in Shanghai Debut, Briefly Hits $66 Billion Valuation
neutral.reason: 競爭對手 Unitree Robotics 上市表現亮眼，雖顯示人形機器人賽道火熱，但對 Tesla 本身股價無直接影響。

neutral.title: Einride Announces Planned Deployment Of 500 Tesla Semi Trucks On Its Saga AI Fleet Intelligence Platform
neutral.reason: 此新聞與 Einride 訂購 500 輛 Tesla Semi 的報導內容重複，選取較具代表性的報導作為 bullish 分類。

neutral.title: Tesla Semi Deployment Triples Einride's Capacity As 500 Units Join Amazon Freight Push
neutral.reason: 與上述 Einride 訂單新聞內容重複，僅補充了 Amazon 參與細節，歸類為中性以避免重複計算。

neutral.title: 'Tesla Readies August Launch of Cybercab, Its Robotaxi Without a Steering Wheel
neutral.reason: 與 Cybercab 奧斯汀發布新聞主題重複，選取較新的報導歸入 bullish 分類。
